description: The ONE person to email at a company, chosen for you: the top decision-maker for this user's own buyer titles whose email address is verified. Use it instead of reading get_company_contacts and weighing verified, catch-all, invalid and unrevealed addresses by hand. It never returns an invalid address, returns a catch-all address only when allow_catch_all is true (ask the user first), and never returns someone this user already contacted on any lane. When no verified address is held it reveals contacts for that company by itself, as long as fewer than reveal_budget companies were revealed in the last hour and monthly reveals remain; past the budget it tells you to ask the user. Reveals spend the user's monthly reveal allowance (the result shows what is left). If it says nobody verified was found, skip the company rather than writing to an unverified address. After a pick, call get_smartsend_draft with that person.

allow_catch_all.description: true only after the user said a catch-all address (the domain accepts every address, so the mailbox cannot be confirmed) is acceptable. Default false.

company.description: Company id, slug, domain or name

reveal.description: false to never spend a reveal in this call. Default true.

reveal_budget.description: Most companies to reveal contacts at within one hour, across calls (default 5, max 25). Raise it only when the user asked for a bigger batch.

name: pick_best_contact
title: Pick the best contact
